# twostates: written by build.sh from toys/twostates.y; do not edit.
level nonassoc PREC_LOW
level left LB
rule 0 s: P R ind LB NUM RB
rule 1 s: Q R elem
rule 2 ind: VAR %prec PREC_LOW
rule 3 elem: VAR LB NUM RB
rule 4 elem: VAR
refuse	-	P
refuse	-	Q
refuse	-	P R
refuse	-	Q R
refuse	-	P R VAR
accept	4:2-3,1:0-3	Q R VAR
refuse	-	P R VAR LB
refuse	-	Q R VAR LB
refuse	-	P R VAR LB NUM
refuse	-	Q R VAR LB NUM
accept	2:2-3,0:0-6	P R VAR LB NUM RB
accept	3:2-6,1:0-6	Q R VAR LB NUM RB
